# Event Time Analysis

```{r, setup, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(magrittr)
library(driveanalytics)

knitr::opts_knit$set(echo = FALSE)

# Get the render format
render_format <- knitr::opts_knit$get('rmarkdown.pandoc.to')
if (render_format == "") render_format <- "html"
```

## Overview

The primary use for this module is to explore and compare the event length distribution between groups (cohorts).

For each group, output includes a histogram, box plot and summary statistics table for the event of interest.

## Methods

For each event, the length is calculated using the start and end date of the event.

The user can choose between:

-   A histogram of the raw or log-transformed event lengths per event type per group
-   A box plot of the event lengths per event type per group (with the option to plot outliers)

The summary table shows the median, mean, and IQR of the event length as well as the event and patient count split by event type and patient group.

## Considerations

This module does not aggregate data at patient level - the output is based on all data points.
Event periods may overlap - this module does not currently check for overlapping events. A more accurate calculation of event length is available in the distribution plots module.

## Example

The following plot and results table are based on a randomly generated set of 10 events across 100 patients.

We can see that

-   The median length of Event J is 5 days in cohort A and 8 days in cohort B.
-   The spread in the length of Event D is larger in cohort A that cohort B.

```{r, example, echo=FALSE, dpi=200, out.width="100%", fig.dim = c(8, 3)}

# create example data
set.seed(123)
n <- 100
n_events <- 10
df_events <- tibble::tibble(
  project_id = 1:n,
  cohort_id = project_id,
  cohort = sample(c("A","B"), n, replace = TRUE),
)
df_events$event <- sample(paste0("Event ", LETTERS[1:n_events]), n, replace = TRUE)
df_events$start_datetime <- sample(
  seq(as.Date("2010-01-01"), as.Date("2020-10-01"), by = "month"),
  size = n,
  replace = TRUE
)
df_events$end_datetime <- df_events$start_datetime + sample(1:10, 100, replace = TRUE)

# get event time analysis results
geta <- driveanalytics::gen_event_time_analysis(df_events, "event", "cohort")
geta$plt
knitr::kable(geta$df) %>% kableExtra::scroll_box(width = "100%") %>% kableExtra::kable_styling(font_size = 10)
```
